verses.text: LORD, why do you stand so far away? Why do you hide when there is trouble?
Proud, wicked people hunt down the weak. Let them be caught in the evil plans they make.
The wicked person boasts about what his heart wants. He praises greedy people and insults the LORD.
The wicked person is so proud that he does not look for God. There is no room for God in his thoughts.
Everything he does always seems to succeed. He is proud, and your laws are far from his mind. He sneers at all his enemies.
He says to himself, "Nothing will shake me. I will never have trouble, for all generations."
His mouth is full of curses, lies, and threats. Trouble and evil are on the tip of his tongue.
He hides and waits near the villages. From his hiding places he murders innocent people. His eyes secretly watch for helpless victims.
He waits in secret like a lion in its den. He waits to catch the helpless. He catches them and drags them off in his net.
The helpless are crushed and fall down. They fall under his strength.
He says to himself, "God has forgotten. He has covered his face. He will never see."
Get up, LORD! God, raise your hand to act! Do not forget the helpless.
Why does the wicked person insult God? Why does he say to himself, "God will not make me answer for it"?
But you do see trouble and sorrow. You notice it and take it into your hands. The victim leaves himself in your care. You help children who have no father.
Break the arm of the wicked and evil person. Search out all his evil until you find no more.
The LORD is King forever and ever! The nations will disappear from his land.
LORD, you have heard what humble people want. You will encourage them, and you will listen to them,
to give justice to children with no father and to those who are crushed, so that mere humans from the earth can no longer terrify anyone.
